modelAssumptions.samplePositions: uniform x from -p/2 to+p/2, including both endpoints
modelAssumptions.interface: one refraction air-to-homogeneous-glass, then straight propagation to y=0
modelAssumptions.validRay: refracted y<0 and backplane hit within +/-p/2; discarded rays excluded from denominator
modelAssumptions.visibility: weighted center-strip hits / weighted valid footprint hits; not brightness or transmission efficiency
modelAssumptions.theta: last contiguous angle from zero where phi>=cutoff; returns0 when zero fails

grid.tieBreak: first strict maximum, r-major then h-major

findings.claim: Supplied1deg source and existing SVG legend report effective theta47,13,8,6,5,4,3,3,2 at phi_min=.7.
Changing only angle resolution to.5deg reproduces every published Fig8c normalized h label after rounding at its stated precision.
Fig8c may originate from a half-degree search version, but no matching original figure-generation script was recovered.
Published theta labels do not match effective theta at phi_min=.7 under either numeric version.
Published theta labels are near curve tails, but exact nonzero/nearzero definition or original implementation was not recovered.
Fig8b N4 phi(0) visually near.78 matches1deg h/p=.408, while Fig8c h/p=.65 predicts approximately.996; b/c appear to mix selection versions.
